subject: Syndicate Hackathon — maintainer provisioning and compute credits
messages:
From: Alexei Morozov <alexei@syndicate.dev>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@syndicate.dev
Date: 2026-11-14T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Syndicate Hackathon — maintainer provisioning and compute credits

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking a look. Syndicate Foundation is running our community HackWeek (Dec 3–5). We want to make sure maintainers from a set of core open-source projects have working inference credits and mentor support during the event. High level ask: 50,000 inference credits (token-equivalent) to be split across ~10 maintainers plus two mentor seats with temporary elevated throughput for 48 hours. We also budgeted small stipends for maintainers ($500 each) and would like to explore whether Redwood can support a partial stipend and credits package or a promo extension for trial users.

Attached: Syndicate_HackWeek_Request.pdf (event brief) and mentor_roster.csv (list of maintainers + emails).

Key constraints:
- Credits need to be provisioned as promo codes or grant codes by Nov 30 so maintainers can onboard.
- Mentor seats should have burst throughput so they can demo and help live.
- We have a small org budget and would appreciate any promo matching.

Would you be the right contact for this? If so, what information do you need for an internal approval? Happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Alexei
Program Director — Syndicate Foundation
From: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Alexei Morozov <alexei@syndicate.dev>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-14T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicate Hackathon — maintainer provisioning and compute credits

Hi Alexei — thanks for the brief and the roster. This is something we can generally support but I need to loop in the credits/product approval folks so we can confirm amounts and any stipend support. Can you confirm: 1) exact list of emails to provision; 2) preferred redemption flow (single promo code vs per-user grants); 3) whether the mentor seats need pin/SSO access or just higher throughput API keys?

I’ve cc’d Marissa (community programs) who usually owns the grants; I’ll also run this by Finance/Partnerships. Aim to get back by end of week.

—Sean
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-14T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Syndicate HackWeek — quick internal (provisional numbers)

Team — forwarding the Syndicate request (attached). Quick read: they asked for 50k credits across ~10 maintainers + 2 mentor seats with a 48-hr burst window. Also requested $500 stipends per maintainer (they only have small org budget).

My thoughts: open-source maintainers program usually lands at ~$300 honorarium unless escalated, and credits can be granted as promo tokens. We need to validate capacity for burst seats — Karthik, can we guarantee short-lived elevated throughput on hosted infra?

Rishi — can Finance/Grants flex on stipend from $300 to $500 for community events? If not, what compromise should we offer that preserves policy but keeps Syndicate happy?

If this looks reasonable I’ll draft an offer: 30k credits + $300/maintainer + two mentor seats (48h burst) and propose per-user grant codes. Thoughts?

—Sean
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicate HackWeek — quick internal (provisional numbers)

Thanks Sean. Reviewing program precedent: for community-run hackathons we typically provide a blended package (credits + mentor seats) and cap stipends to $300 unless there is a direct escalation to Partnerships leadership. Proposal for Syndicate:

- Credits: 30,000 token-equivalent credits split as per their roster; pref per-user grants so we can revoke if misused.
- Stipend: $300 per maintainer (total up to $3,000 for 10 maintainers).
- Mentor seats: 2 premium mentor API keys with a 48-hour explicit burst window (we'll set rate limits and fallback to a smaller model variant if needed).
- Redemption: per-email grant codes issued via our promo pipeline; require re-confirmation of recipient emails by Nov 25.

I attached a draft promo code list (internal) and the event brief with proposed limits. If Finance can bump stipends we can reconsider; otherwise offer the blended package and an opt-in note to apply for extra support in future events.

—Marissa
Senior Community Programs Manager — Redwood Inference
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-17T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicate HackWeek — approval (finance)

On Tue, Nov 16, 2026 at 09:05, marissa.cole@redwood.ai wrote:
> Thanks Sean. Reviewing program precedent: for community-run hackathons we typically provide a blended package (credits + mentor seats) and cap stipends to $300 unless there is a direct escalation to Partnerships leadership. Proposal for Syndicate:

I’m okay with the blended package as outlined. Finance will approve up to $3,000 in stipend spend (i.e., $300 x 10 maintainers) and the 30k credits allocation. Please ensure the promo grants have redemption tracking enabled and an expiration window (90 days). Karthik, confirm ops can provision the burst mentor keys and we’ll include a short approval memo for audit.

Rishi
Head of Finance & Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Alexei Morozov <alexei@syndicate.dev>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicate Hackathon — maintainer provisioning and compute credits (Approved)

Hi Alexei — good news: Redwood is able to support Syndicate HackWeek with a community package. Summary of what we can provide:

- 30,000 inference credits, allocated as per the roster you provided (we’ll issue per-email grant codes).
- Honorarium: $300 per maintainer (up to 10 maintainers; total $3,000), paid via standard partner stipend workflow.
- Mentor seats: 2 premium mentor API keys with a 48-hour burst window (we will attach explicit rate limits and a fallback to a smaller compatible model if needed).

Next steps for Syndicate: please confirm final list of recipient emails by Nov 25 and whether you want single-use codes or persistent grants. We will create the promo codes and share redemption instructions and a short onboarding doc. Promo codes will expire in 90 days.

Attached: Syndicate_HackWeek_Request.pdf, mentor_roster.csv, internal_approval_memo.pdf

If you’d like a short call to walk maintainers through onboarding and best practices for batching and caching during demos, Marissa can host a 30-minute session the week before the event.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0198
